activities.description: Tracks set yesterday and still holding at ten.
activities.name: Bohart Ranch, morning classic

activities.description: Eleven hundred and eighty metres and I felt every one of them.
activities.name: Bell Lake Yurt, up the north side

activities.description: Out over the saddle and down to the truck by two.
activities.name: Bell Lake Yurt, second day, legs knew about it
Bohart Ranch, short one before dark

activities.description: Every loop they groom, in order, and a thermos in the car at the end of it.
activities.name: Bohart Ranch, long Sunday
Highland Glen, skate, fast and cold
Sourdough trail, wet snow by the bridge
Bohart Ranch, Sunday with the dogs at the car

activities.description: Hard snow, no wind, forty five minutes, and I have nothing else to say about it.
activities.name: Highland Glen, skate, best day of the year

activities.description: Soft by the parking lot and fine everywhere else. Last week of it.
activities.name: Bohart Ranch, corn by four o'clock

activities.description: Six inches Thursday and it was still good at two. That is the season. The watch goes in the drawer tomorrow.
activities.name: Last day at Bridger Bowl
Up the road with both dogs
Dogs to the fence line and back

activities.description: Dry to the top. That is the summer started.
activities.name: Drinking Horse, first dry evening
Sypes Canyon, up fast down slow

activities.description: Both dogs. Down took longer than up.
activities.name: Sypes Canyon, up fast down slow

activities.description: Snow in the last gully. Up in ninety minutes and down in two hours, which is the whole story of this knee.
activities.name: Sacagawea Pass from Fairy Lake

activities.description: Ozias brought a spare rod, the nymph box and no opinions until the second hour. Three hours on the bank and I walked most of it.
activities.name: East Gallatin, first evening with a rod

activities.description: Eighty two degrees and Bjorn sat down at the second cattle guard and waited for me. Not sore, just finished. Saga would have gone twice.
activities.name: Sypes Canyon, turned round at the second cattle guard

activities.description: The riffle above the bridge. Two browns to Ozias and none to me. He says I lift the rod at the end of the drift, and he is right.
activities.name: East Gallatin, three hours of fishing recorded as a walk

activities.description: This is fishing. Ozias worked the riffle and I walked the bank between holes. Two browns, both his.
activities.name: East Gallatin, walking between holes

activities.description: Five weight and the waders that do not leak. More walking between holes than casting, which suits me.
activities.name: Springhill bridge, water dropping
The M, wind out of the south
Beehive Basin, snow still in the gully

activities.description: He took the rig apart on the tailgate and put it back together twice. I understood about half of it standing in the water.
activities.name: East Gallatin, the nymph rig again, slowly

activities.description: The distance is not the point. Lost a nymph in a willow and Ozias retied it without comment.
activities.name: East Gallatin again, mostly standing still

activities.description: Saga ate something on the gravel on the way down. Films at half three.
activities.name: Sypes Canyon, Saga found something

activities.description: Started late because of the heat and stayed until it was dark. Asked him on the bank how the rig goes together and got the proper answer at eleven at night.
activities.name: Springhill bridge, hot week, late start

activities.description: Nine hundred metres and nothing hurt going up. Renata will want to hear about the descent.
activities.name: Sacagawea Pass from Fairy Lake, second time

activities.description: Tied it the way he wrote it down, including cutting the leader back. Moved the indicator before I changed the fly, which is the whole lesson.
activities.name: East Gallatin, three fish and no tangles

activities.description: Walked further than we fished. Roof crew finished at the barn today, so I was in no hurry to go home and look at it.
activities.name: Springhill bridge down, evening

activities.description: Third campus in four days. The dogs had been in the car since ten and told us about it for an hour.
activities.name: Moscow, both dogs after the campus tour

activities.description: Broke the drive at the pass and walked eleven and a half kilometres of it. Step downs three times a week since the twenty first and the descent was better.
activities.name: Lolo Pass, on the way home

activities.description: Home two days and back up the canyon. Warm at the lake and cold the whole way down through the trees.
activities.name: Lava Lake and back
The M, dogs off the road again

activities.description: Axtell Bridge because everything closer is too warm. He read the thermometer at seven, it said sixty four, so we fished.
activities.name: Gallatin at Axtell, sixty four degrees

activities.description: Mended the rig the way he wrote it down. Three fish and no tangles, which is a first.
activities.name: East Gallatin, the rig held

activities.description: Walked the north half of the ridge to see what we are in for on the fifteenth.
activities.name: Sacagawea Pass from Fairy Lake, reconnaissance

activities.description: Fine going up. Slow coming down, as usual.
activities.name: Storm Castle

activities.description: Knee has been fine on this trail all month. Four days to the ridge and no reason to spend anything tonight.
activities.name: Sypes Canyon, half of it before dinner

activities.description: Easy legs before Saturday.
activities.name: Hyalite Reservoir, low water

activities.description: Nineteen and a half miles with Dagny Foss. Fairy Lake at twenty to six, Sacagawea by half nine, Baldy at three. Four hours and forty minutes to the high point and six hours and twenty four minutes to get off the thing. Going up has never been the problem.
activities.name: Bridger ridge, Fairy Lake to the M — 19.6 with Dagny

activities.description: Eight evenings on the river since the fourteenth of June and Ozias thinks that is the last of them. School and the groundbreaking take the calendar back now.
activities.name: Gallatin at Axtell, the eighth

activities.description: Off the East Gallatin because it is too warm. Ozias measured the temperature before he let either of us cast.
activities.name: Gallatin at Axtell, warm water and slow

activities.description: Eighth and last of these. Dark on the walk back to the truck. Curling starts again in October and I will miss this.
activities.name: Gallatin at Axtell, last river evening
The M, dogs off the road
Storm Castle, last Saturday of August
